title: Local job-application builder
summary: Paste a JD and receive a readable tailored resume PDF, cover-letter PDF, application JSON and reusable chat context.
body: Two layers: this coding-memory harness helps Lohith and an agent build the separate application pipeline. Preserve existing agreements; avoid universal-framework work. The full source-agreement is the detailed plan; modules and checkpoints route to exact sections. Fresh sessions must explain current position, then follow Lohith's steering.
change_reason: Initial migration: preserve source context and current user intent
